ROLLCALL_STORE_DIR: Snapshot directory, the only place Rollcall writes
ROLLCALL_GITLAB_URL: https:// base URL of the GitLab instance
ROLLCALL_GITLAB_TOKEN: A GitLab group or project access token (a bot), or a service account's token, with the read_api scope only, the Reporter role and an expiry. The stack's is the group token rollcall-scanner, rotated by the stack maintainer (docs/security.md). Never in git, never logged, never printed
ROLLCALL_GITLAB_GROUPS: Comma-separated group ids or paths; subgroups are included. Ignored when ROLLCALL_GITLAB_PROJECTS is set
ROLLCALL_GITLAB_PROJECTS: Comma-separated full group/project paths; when set, only those projects are scanned and no group is listed
ROLLCALL_CITADEL_EXPORT: Citadel's saved registrations export, used instead of ROLLCALL_IMAGES_FILE (not both): base images plus forced upgrade dates. See the Citadel guide
ROLLCALL_PROCTOR_DIR: PROCTOR JSON reports, one per app: group/project is read from group__project.json
ROLLCALL_AUTH_PACKAGES: Comma-separated Composer packages that count as an auth package
ROLLCALL_RETENTION_DAYS: How many days of snapshots to keep; the newest is never deleted
ROLLCALL_OWNERS_FILE: Owners file for the digests: who answers for which apps, and who opted in with "digest": true. Rollcall's own, for the stack's projects, is owners.json in the repo (roles only); keep another fleet's outside a public repo
ROLLCALL_OWNERS_CONFIRM_DAYS: How long an owners-file entry's "confirmed" date counts; past it, `rollcall owners` calls that owner unknown and exits 1
ROLLCALL_DIGEST_MAIL_DSN: Symfony Mailer DSN for sending, such as smtp://mail.example.test:25. A secret: never in git, never printed
ROLLCALL_DIGEST_MAIL_FROM: The from address of the digests
ROLLCALL_METRICS_TOKEN: Bearer token a scraper must present
ROLLCALL_INTERNAL_ENABLED: Laravel: serve the per-app page at `<path>/apps` (needs your sign-in middleware)
ROLLCALL_WAYNEUI_CSS: Laravel: https:// or absolute URL of WayneUI's stylesheet for the dashboard
